title: New Year and Days
statementMd:
Today is Wednesday, the third day of the week. What's more interesting is that tomorrow is the last day of the year 2015.

Limak is a little polar bear. He enjoyed this year a lot. Now, he is so eager to the coming year 2016.

Limak wants to prove how responsible a bear he is. He is going to regularly save candies for the entire year 2016! He considers various saving plans. He can save one candy either on some fixed day of the week or on some fixed day of the month.

Limak chose one particular plan. He isn't sure how many candies he will save in the 2016 with his plan. Please, calculate it and tell him.

## Input

The only line of the input is in one of the following two formats:

- "`x of week`" where $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ 7$) denotes the day of the week. The 1-st day is Monday and the 7-th one is Sunday.
- "`x of month`" where $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ 31$) denotes the day of the month.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of candies Limak will save in the year 2016.

## Note

Polar bears use the Gregorian calendar. It is the most common calendar and you likely use it too. You can read about it on Wikipedia if you want to – [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar). The week starts with Monday.

In the first sample Limak wants to save one candy on each Thursday (the 4-th day of the week). There are $52$ Thursdays in the 2016. Thus, he will save $52$ candies in total.

In the second sample Limak wants to save one candy on the 30-th day of each month. There is the 30-th day in exactly $11$ months in the 2016 — all months but February. It means that Limak will save $11$ candies in total.
statementZhMd:
今天是星期三，一周中的第三天。更有趣的是，明天就是 2015 年的最后一天。

Limak 是一只小北极熊。他非常享受这一年。现在，他已经迫不及待地期待即将到来的 2016 年了。

Limak 想证明自己是一只多么负责任的熊。他打算在整个 2016 年定期存糖果！他考虑了各种存糖果计划。他可以选择在每周的某个固定日期存一颗糖果，也可以选择在每月的某个固定日期存一颗糖果。

Limak 选择了其中一种计划。他不确定按照自己的计划，在 2016 年会存下多少颗糖果。请计算这个数量并告诉他。

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行采用以下两种格式之一：

- `x of week`，其中 $*x*$（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ 7$）表示星期几。第 1 天是星期一，第 7 天是星期日。
- `x of month`，其中 $*x*$（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ 31$）表示每月的第几天。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Limak 在 2016 年将存下的糖果数量。

## 说明

北极熊使用公历。这是最常见的历法，你很可能也在使用它。如果你愿意，可以在 Wikipedia 上阅读相关内容：[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gregorian_calendar)。一周从星期一开始。

在第一个样例中，Limak 想在每个星期四（星期中的第 4 天）存一颗糖果。2016 年共有 $52$ 个星期四。因此，他总共会存下 $52$ 颗糖果。

在第二个样例中，Limak 想在每个月的第 30 天存一颗糖果。2016 年恰好有 $11$ 个月存在第 30 天——除了二月之外的所有月份。这意味着 Limak 总共会存下 $11$ 颗糖果。
